Implemented the cached blog posts page.

- Fetches posts through `getPosts()`
- Uses Next.js Cache Components with `'use cache'`
- Revalidates every hour via `cacheLife('hours')`
- Tags the cache with `cacheTag('posts')` for on-demand invalidation
- Renders post titles and authors
- Enables `cacheComponents` in [next.config.ts](/workspace/next.config.ts)

Updated [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx). TypeScript and the production build both pass; the build confirms a 1-hour revalidation interval.
